connect.title: Connect your mailbox
connect.subtitle: Enter your email to discover settings and connect.
connect.name: Display name
connect.success_body: You can close this window or continue to the next step.
connect.invalid: This connect link is invalid or has expired.
connect.disabled: Mailbox connect is not available right now.
connect.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
connect.error_csrf: The form expired. Reload the page and try again.
connect.error_validation: Check the email and password and try again.

branding.title: Hosted page branding
branding.subtitle: Logos, colours, and sanitised HTML for the public connect page and the admin theme.
branding.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF · max 2 MB · no SVG
branding.logo_dark_hint: Optional. Shown on the connect page when dark mode is on.
branding.favicon_hint: ICO, PNG or JPEG · max 256 KB
branding.header_html_hint: Shown above the connect form. Use /v1/public/branding/assets/… for uploaded images. Scripts are stripped.
branding.head_html_hint: Only meta, https stylesheets, and safe style blocks are kept.
branding.preview_note: Preview uses the same sanitiser as the public page (sandboxed).
branding.upload_drop: Drop an image here or choose a file
branding.palette_hint: Optional overrides for the admin and connect themes. Unset colours keep the EmailBridge defaults. The server refuses palettes that fail WCAG AA for body text.
branding.images_hint: General images for header HTML. Copy the public URL into an img src.
branding.no_permission_body: You need organisation access to edit hosted-page branding.
branding.return_url_hosts_hint: Extra exact host names (no scheme, port, path or wildcard) that hosted connect links may redirect to after success, besides this EmailBridge host. At most 20. Never shown on the public page.
branding.remove_body: The image is deleted from the branding assets. Pages that use it fall back to the default.
